description: This Swift source file defines the GatewayLaunchAgentManager enum responsible for managing macOS launch agents related to the Gateway component of an application. It includes functions to enable/disable, check status, and restart the launch agent, as well as handle related configurations and logging paths.

methods.name: isLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent write operations are disabled by the presence of a marker file.

methods.name: setLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Creates or removes the disable launch agent marker file based on the boolean parameter, thus enabling or disabling the write access.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the daemon is loaded by reading its current state.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent, with optional bundle path and port parameters, executing appropriate commands.

methods.name: kickstart
methods.description: Restarts or refreshes the launch agent daemon.

methods.name: launchdConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the current launch agent configuration.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the gateway log, prioritizing stdout and stderr paths from the current launch agent configuration.
